title: Privileged Access Policy
provenance: Synthetic academic example; not an actual agency policy or authoritative guidance.

sections.heading: Vendor access
sections.passage: Vendor administrative access to production systems must be approved, time-limited, least-privileged, and protected by multifactor authentication (MFA). Permanent privileged vendor access or access without MFA requires rejection or formal security exception review.

sections.heading: Security exceptions
sections.passage: Requests to bypass authentication, access controls or security monitoring must be reviewed by the security owner and documented before implementation.
